name: agent-board
description: See what every AI coding agent is doing, with whatever is waiting on you at the top: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and more

language.title: Pane language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; or pick English, 繁體中文, 简体中文.

autoConnect.title: Connect other agents automatically
autoConnect.description: Each Claude Code session hooks any coding agent installed on this machine (Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Muse Code, OpenClaw) into the pane, and says what it did. /progress connect remove also turns this off.
